title: AI Strategy & Readiness
description: AI readiness assessment, opportunity roadmap and architecture review from senior Techlio engineers, before you commit to a build.
h1: Know what to build, and what to leave alone.
intro: Before you fund a build, get an engineer’s read on it. We review your stack and workflows, rank the AI opportunities by value and feasibility, and design the first one in enough detail to estimate honestly.
caption: Evidence from a stack review and workflow interviews becomes a list of use cases, scored for value and feasibility, then sorted into build now or not yet.
offerIntro: Four stages, in order, usually over two to four weeks.

offerings.title: AI readiness assessment
offerings.text: A free first review of your stack, workflows and goals that tells you where you stand and whether a deeper engagement is worth it.

offerings.title: Opportunity ranking
offerings.text: Every candidate use case written up the same way and scored on value, feasibility and risk, with the assumptions stated.

offerings.title: Target architecture
offerings.text: A design for the top-ranked item: data flow, model choices, guardrails, tenancy and how it fits the systems you already run.

offerings.title: Estimate and plan
offerings.text: A phased plan and a price range with assumptions, written so your own team could build from it without us.

why.title: Engineers, not slideware
why.text: The people advising you are the ones who would build it. Recommendations come with a design, not just a diagram of boxes.

why.title: Comfortable saying no
why.text: If an idea is not ready, we say so and list what would make it ready. A parked idea costs less than a failed build.

why.title: Yours to keep
why.text: You own the roadmap, architecture and estimate. Build with us, build in-house or take it to another vendor.

closeTitle: Start with a free AI readiness assessment
closeText: Thirty minutes with a senior engineer, a look at your stack and goals, and a straight answer on where AI will and will not pay off.

card.lead: Decide what to build before you pay to build it.
card.text: A readiness assessment, a ranked list of AI opportunities and an architecture your team or ours can build from.

faqs.question: What do we receive at the end?
faqs.answer: A written assessment of your data and systems, a ranked list of AI opportunities with expected effort and value, a target architecture, and a build estimate.

faqs.question: Do we have to build with Techlio afterwards?
faqs.answer: No. The output is written so your own engineers or another vendor can build from it.

faqs.question: How is this different from a strategy firm?
faqs.answer: The people doing the assessment are senior engineers who ship AI systems, so recommendations come with the technical detail and trade-offs needed to act on them.

faqs.question: What do you need from us?
faqs.answer: Access to the people who run the workflows, a view of the systems and data involved, and a named decision-maker. We keep the time asked of your team small.

faqs.question: We are not sure we are ready for AI. Is this still useful?
faqs.answer: Yes. Finding out that a use case is not worth building, or that the data needs work first, saves the cost of a failed pilot.

metaTitle: AI Strategy, Readiness Assessment and Architecture
answer: AI consulting from Techlio is a short, practical engagement that tells you where AI will pay off in your business, what to build first, and what it will take. You get a readiness assessment, a ranked list of use cases, an architecture your own team or any vendor could build from, and a realistic estimate, written by engineers who build these systems.
